      • testTSOUpdate

        public void testTSOUpdate()
        This method depends on testROUpdate(). It will extend that test by running through the same process, only involving a TSO reflection. The default federate is regulating, with a lookahead of 5. The second federate will be neither constrained, nor regulating, and so should receive all reflections as RO. The third federate will be constrained, and as such, should not receive the event until it has advanced to the proper time, and when it does it should recieve it as TSO.
